title: Exit labels for copy operations
statement: For each copy-operation site, assign its continuation label as follows: either multiplication site continues at the corresponding multiplication test; radius setup continues at phase $0$ of the squaring multiplication site; shift-value setup continues at phase $0$ of the shift of the setup register; root-level copying continues at the recursive-call label; pushing continues at phase $0$ of the corresponding push shift; copying the stack during a pop continues at phase $0$ of the first pop-count copy; the first pop-count copy continues at phase $0$ of the corresponding halving operation; copying the halved stack continues at phase $0$ of the second pop-count copy; and the second pop-count copy continues at phase $0$ of the corresponding pop shift.
hypotheses_covered: The input is a copy-operation site
The label type is parameterized by a natural number $E$
